title: The Last Light
notes: The recording on his DA-1000, lying in the road under the one faulty streetlight at the end of the outskirts road (docs/plans/outskirts-losing-himself.md). Early days: the two of them out at night with this same recorder, narrating an ordinary street like a nature documentary. About 90 seconds; it plays out once he is standing where the reflection was, it cannot be stopped, and the light fails on the last word. The voices are Seb's to record: until an audio file exists (public/assets/audio/outskirts/last-light.mp3), main plays room tone and tape hiss and shows these lines at their `at` seconds. Every line is a draft for Seb to revise first; the one that has to land is "We'll do another one. We'll do loads."

lines.text: [Tape hiss. A click. Wind across the mic, and traffic a long way off.]
Testing. Testing. This is... what is this.
It's the street. Tell them it's the street.
This... is the street.
[She laughs straight into the mic. It peaks.]
Here we see the lamp post, in its natural habitat. Solitary. Nocturnal.
He's lonely.
He's not lonely. He's got a job to do.
(low, as the lamp) I light the pavement. Nobody thanks me.
[Both of them gone, laughing, a long way from the mic.]
Keep it down, keep it down, there's one coming.
[A bus pulling in. The doors hiss open. Nobody gets on.]
(whispering) The night bus. Nobody knows where it goes. Nobody has ever come back.
It's the forty-two. It goes to my mum's.
Nobody has ever come back from your mum's.
[The doors close. She's laughing so hard she has to sit down on the kerb.]
Give it here. Give it. It's my turn.
[The mic changes hands. Closer now, her breath on it.]
And here we have the recordist. Rare. Very shy. Only comes out at night.
Don't.
He's pretending he isn't listening. He's always listening.
He thinks he's recording the street. He's recording me.
[Nothing for a while but the street.]
...Yeah.
What are we going to do with this?
Keep it. We'll play it when we're old.
We'll do another one. We'll do loads.
Loads.
[She's already walking away, calling something back. He follows. The mic knocks against something.]
[Click.]
